name: sticky-banner
title: Sticky Banner
description: A full-width announcement bar that slides down at the top of the page, stays pinned while scrolling, and disappears when its close icon is clicked.
use: A launch, funding or sale deserves a one-line note across the top of every page.
avoid: The bright sticky band covers content and can nag on mobile unless hide-on-scroll is enabled.
a11y: The close button is labelled and focusable, but the bar vanishes without notice and ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A saturated blue band spans the top of the page with small white text and an underlined link, plus a small white X at the right end. Below it sits a dark blog page with photos and article text.
behaves: The bar drops in from above on load, stays sticky at the top as the page scrolls, and slides back out of view when the X is clicked. It can also hide itself on scroll when that option is on.
customise: Content is children; className sets the colours and hideOnScroll adds scroll-away behaviour. Duration, offsets and the close icon live in the source.
weight: light: One scroll listener plus short translate and opacity transitions.
demo: The line 'Announcing our $12M Series A, led by Northzone. Read the announcement' above a Northwind blog.
polishWhy: Clean blue bar with a clear action; nothing distinctive beyond the sticky behaviour.
